meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: Claude 会用 deepTools 命令行工具处理测序数据:把 BAM 转成归一化的 bigWig 覆盖度轨道,做质控与样本比较,并生成热图、剖面图。
howto.when: 当你提到“BAM 转 bigWig”“ChIP-seq 质控”“热图”等关键词,或要求做 RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 覆盖度分析、样本相关性或 PCA 比较时接管。

howto.what_en: Claude runs deepTools command-line tools on sequencing data: converting BAM to normalized bigWig coverage tracks, running QC and sample comparison, and generating heatmaps and profile plots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention BAM to bigWig, ChIP-seq QC, heatmaps and similar terms, or ask for RNA-seq/ATAC-seq coverage analysis or sample correlation and PCA comparison.
